# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 17 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_017_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 17

**1** Jesus said: "I will give you what no eye has ever seen, what no ear has ever heard, what no hand has ever touched, and what has never entered any human mind."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Ever" repeated — the repeated emphasis stresses the absolute and universal exclusion
- "Entered any human mind" — renders the heart/mind idiom as cognitive entry
- The saying is a promise of the utterly unprecedented; its brevity is its power

---
